build: Release arm64; production SwiftUI sources in finance.shilling.perf
baselineRevision: d715790 plus September 29 Plan/Receipts follow-up and identical new fixture instrumentation
notes: Synthetic offline Store5 graph; no ordinary app data or sync session.
Home: three fresh processes per variant. Editor process: three cycles of four editors, each with twenty parent updates before closing.
editors-candidate is the intermediate targeted-read build. editors-final additionally bounds recurrence generation and reuses date defaults.
Two final editor processes give six openings per editor, compared with two baseline processes. An interrupted editor cohort was discarded because an Instruments launch terminated its second process.
Home cohort predates independent final editor-only date changes; final Home smoke is recorded separately.
Load measures mounting to populated views plus 50 ms display allowance, not full production app launch.
First baseline Home load was 1264.6 ms, other baseline loads were 205.2 and 220.4 ms. All retained; medians do not claim a one-second improvement.
Cursor row counts are rows materialized at the SQLDelight boundary, not all SQLite rows visited. Query/listener/row counter overhead is present in both variants.
activeListeners counts (table key, listener) registrations. Controller release and no remaining reads do not constitute a full allocation census.
Home updates modify a fixed probe posting outside the three visible rows. Visible-row and metadata update behavior is covered by Store5 JVM tests.
CPU is process user plus system time; RSS is an end-of-phase snapshot, not peak memory.
Display callback gaps do not independently measure GPU presentation time. Time Profiler inclusive frame counts overlap.
